note: Capability-aware seat routing (WebGPT design, ask run ask-tau-design-question-where-should-a-s-c7125c30a43e). Routes carry CAPABILITIES, not naked model strings: a fallback is a list of route ids, and a route is eligible for a seat only when route.capabilities superset-covers seat.requires. The repair_creator deliberately has NO fallback (only the codex workspace transport can author) and parks on quota; reviewers/auditors are non-codex-first so review work never burns the scarce authoring transport. Seat-ROUTING selection lives here; transport mechanics (endpoints, retries, provider failover) stay internal to SciLLM/Tau; project intent stays in registry/projects.json.
